title: Vivian Blank 20
author: bpatrick
html: Vivian Blank page 20. I was having problems with the lawyer-guy’s mask. If you look in the cover gallery there’s a picture with the original idea I had. At the last minute I wasn’t into it. I had recently watched some Suede videos online and there you go: Pig-head. I like it much better. By the way, aren’t music videos great? I miss them. I was sitting at my computer and suddenly realized I had never seen a Suede video which is kind of crazy ’cause I listen to them almost daily. It’s kind of ironic after all the criticism aimed at music videos claiming they were destroying attention spans that the modern audience has no patience for them.
